decision: stage 1 is not repaired (human-set, 2026-09-21); these weaknesses are documented, not fixed

weaknesses.weakness: Interval coverage below nominal, and the deficit is a heavy tail a Gaussian cannot carry
weaknesses.effect: Most cells are over-covered (median |z| about 0.3) while a few percent are far outside any interval; scaling sigma to reach 90% coverage raises mean CRPS from 26.05 to 35.65.
weaknesses.stage2_can_address: No -- a stage 2 that adds to the mean cannot change the shape of the predictive distribution.
weaknesses.stage1_fork_not_taken: A count or heavier-tailed predictive family (negative binomial, zero-truncated normal), with a verified CRPS for it (plan §4b 2026-09-21: not taken, human-set).

weaknesses.weakness: Negative forecast means for a count
weaknesses.effect: 4.0% of stage 1's forecast means are below zero, concentrated in Savannakhet after its 2008 collapse; clipping them alone lowers mean CRPS by 0.56%.
weaknesses.stage2_can_address: Partly -- every stage-2 candidate from batch 10 on clips the corrected mean at zero.
weaknesses.stage1_fork_not_taken: A non-negative predictive family, or a log1p transform with bias-corrected back-transform.

weaknesses.weakness: The standard error does not grow with the forecast level as a count's variance does
weaknesses.effect: The se is set by the training window's innovation variance, so a province whose level collapsed keeps an se tens of times its current level (Savannakhet: se 200-414, mean actual 8), and a province whose level rose has an se far too small (|z| up to 164). A standardised correction inherits this: the same z-hat is 130-190 cases in Savannakhet and under one case in Xiangkhouang.
weaknesses.stage2_can_address: Partly -- bounding the correction relative to the forecast level (i_boundedBoosting) limits the damage; it does not fix the interval.
weaknesses.stage1_fork_not_taken: A variance that scales with the mean (count family), or a multiplicative model.

weaknesses.weakness: Systematic multi-step bias: over-prediction at high forecast levels and in November-April, under-prediction in the June-July onset
weaknesses.effect: Two thirds of forecasts are too high; the few that are too low are far too low. The seasonal AR term carries last year's level into the off-season and lags the onset.
weaknesses.stage2_can_address: Yes -- this is the structure the batch-10 candidates learned (forecast level, month, horizon), and the reason they earn their place at 2-3 months ahead.
weaknesses.stage1_fork_not_taken: A different seasonal specification (the airline model was run as a perturbation: stage 1 alone worse, corrected forecast similar), or a transform.

weaknesses.weakness: Reporting-regime breaks in the test years that no province's own history predicts

evidence.context: Laos moved from paper-based reporting to the electronic EWARN system in 2008 and not all provinces reported before 2010 (Khampapongpane et al. 2014, WPSAR; batch 10 report)

weaknesses.effect: Savannakhet fell from 166 to 8 cases a month between the training window and 2008-09; Bokeo rose from 0.7 to 39, Salavan from 4 to 61. These cells are the coverage deficit and much of the CRPS.
weaknesses.stage2_can_address: Only after the break is a few months old (recent-residual and reporting-level features); not at the break.
weaknesses.stage1_fork_not_taken: A level-shift or intervention term; a rolling window (run as a perturbation: stage 1 alone better at 23.99, and the corrected forecast still ahead).

weaknesses.weakness: The specification was a first default, not a selected one

evidence.stage1_spec: SARIMAX(1, 1, 1)x(1, 0, 0, 12), raw disease_cases, refit every split
evidence.alternative_specifications_scored_at: ../06_stability/results/perturbation_effects.csv (rows stage1=* and window=*: stage-1-alone mean CRPS under each)

weaknesses.effect: Stage 1 alone beats both required baselines (03_baselines/results/comparison.json). Its own score moves materially under alternative orders and windows (06_stability/results/perturbation_effects.csv); the stage-2 margin survives every one of them, but the absolute level of the two-stage forecast depends on them.
weaknesses.stage2_can_address: Not applicable -- this is a statement about what the premise is.
weaknesses.stage1_fork_not_taken: Order selection by information criterion or by backtest; both are selection on the same development data and were deliberately not done (plan §4b, 2026-09-21).
